decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Informative: This planning permission does not give consent for the single-storey-side extension currently under construction at the site. The certificate of lawfulness reference 00364/4/LAW1 for the side extension is now invalid, because the side extension was not completed prior to the erection of the single-storey rear extension. The side extension therefore requires full planning permission. The Council's Head of Enforcement has been advised of this matter.

Condition : 7 - The proposed single-storey rear extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The proposal would accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house
